v1_boundary.ProtTox-3DKD v1: immutable strict baseline; no code/checkpoint modification

model.name: MPCE-Net B

views.mean/max/std: Frozen ProtT5 TriStat subvectors, each projected to 64d

model.global_branch: MLP over projected views + interaction vector -> logit
model.prototype_branch: 4 prototypes per class in 96d latent; cosine similarity; LogSumExp class affinity
model.fusion: z_final = z_global + alpha*z_proto, alpha learnable initialized to 0

controls.A0: original TriStat-MLP no-KD OOF (existing runs/protox_tsk_v1 mlp_fivefold)

promotion_gate.note: If B does not pass, do not implement ensemble C.
